import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorSheaf
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Smooth.StandardSmoothCotangent
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Kaehler
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Localization

/-!
# Rational differentials on a smooth curve

The space of rational differentials of a smooth integral curve is one-dimensional
over its function field.  The proof localizes the differential module of a
standard-smooth affine chart.  This is the generic-fiber input to the construction
of a canonical divisor; it does not construct the differential sheaf, its divisor,
or a Serre-duality pairing.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

/-- The algebra structure extending the ground-field action on rational functions.
It is installed only locally, like `functionFieldOverModule`. -/
@[reducible] def functionFieldOverAlgebra (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X] : Algebra k X.functionField :=
  (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap k X).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra

/-- The ground-field algebra structure on a stalk, induced by the structure
morphism and the germ at the point. -/
@[reducible] def stalkOverAlgebra (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  ((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤)).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] stalkOverAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- The module of differentials of a curve's local ring over the ground field. -/
abbrev CurveStalkDifferentials (x : X.left) := Ω[X.left.presheaf.stalk x⁄k]

/-- The space of rational differentials, with its structure-morphism ground-field
action. -/
abbrev CurveRationalDifferentials := Ω[X.left.functionField⁄k]

omit [IsIntegral X.left] in
/-- Standard-smooth curve charts over the original ground-field algebra map. -/
theorem smoothCurve_exists_standardSmooth_affineOpen
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] (x : X.left) :
    ∃ V : X.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧
      (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hxV, e, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
      (n := 1) (f := X.hom) x
  have hUtop : U = ⊤ := by
    have hsub : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
    refine Opens.ext (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun y => ?_)
    exact Subsingleton.elim (X.hom.base x) y ▸ e hxV
  subst hUtop
  refine ⟨V, hV, hxV, ?_⟩
  have h := hsm.comp (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.equiv
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm)
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

omit [IsIntegral X.left] in
/-- The differentials of each local ring of a smooth curve form a
free module of rank one. -/
theorem smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] (x : X.left) :
    Module.Free (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveStalkDifferentials X x) ∧
      Module.rank (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveStalkDifferentials X x) = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hsmk⟩ := smoothCurve_exists_standardSmooth_affineOpen X x
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 k Γ(X.left, V) :=
    hsmk.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, V) := hsmk.isStandardSmooth.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    change (X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r) =
      (X.left.presheaf.germ V x hxV).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V r)
    have hres := X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))
      x hxV (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r)
    rw [X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op r] at hres
    exact hres.symm
  let M := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule M
      (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    KaehlerDifferential.isLocalizedModule_map k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) M
  refine ⟨Module.free_of_isLocalizedModule (R := Γ(X.left, V))
    (Rₛ := X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (S := M)
    (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)), ?_⟩
  have hrank := Module.lift_rank_of_isLocalizedModule_of_free (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
  rw [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := k) (S := Γ(X.left, V)) 1] at hrank
  simpa using hrank

/-- The rational differentials on an integral smooth curve have rank one over
the function field. -/
theorem rank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    Module.rank X.left.functionField (CurveRationalDifferentials X) = 1 :=
  (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X (genericPoint X.left)).2

/-- Rational differentials form a one-dimensional vector space over the
function field. -/
theorem finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    Module.finrank X.left.functionField (CurveRationalDifferentials X) = 1 :=
  Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq (rank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X)

/-- A smooth integral curve has a nonzero rational differential.  No particular
differential is selected by this existence statement. -/
theorem exists_nonzero_curveRationalDifferential [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X, ω ≠ 0 := by
  apply (rank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero (R := X.left.functionField)).mp
  rw [rank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X]
  exact zero_lt_one

end
end Hartshorne
